The plate is about 26 cm wide and spans roughly 345 px, so about 13 px per cm. The pizza slice measures about 190 px by 170 px, or roughly 14 cm by 12 cm. It looks like a square-cut slice of pepperoni pizza about 1 cm thick, with four pepperoni pieces on top.

Its area is about 14 × 12 ≈ 150 cm², allowing for the slice's rotation and corners. At 1 cm thick that is about 150 cm³. Pizza is fairly airy, so I assume roughly 0.5 g/cm³, which gives about 75–100 g. A typical cafeteria square slice weighs about 110 g, so I'll use 110 g.

Cafeteria pizza runs about 2.7 kcal/g, so 110 g comes to roughly 300 kcal.
